title: BlockAllocation - allocation of a block to a holder (Section 7)
description: Coordination is required only here. Use of serial numbers within a block is offline and in any order.

class.description: The tariff and the form the journal opens in, not an anchoring regime for life (core v2 section 9): heavy opens Pro; light opens light and may go Pro; bare stays light and is never anchored.

expires_at.description: After this moment, unused serial numbers of the block are invalid (Section 7, rule 4).

prev_closure.description: Required from the second block onward (Section 7, rule 3). For the first block the field is OMITTED, not set to null: an absent field and null are different documents (Section 3).
